title: Anatomy of a Club Charter
description: A club charter is one document made of five distinct sections. See what each section governs and how they differ.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Writing Your Club Charter and Safety Policies

educational.audience: Coding club leaders and student officers drafting a charter

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given the term "club charter," the learner identifies the five sections it typically contains and states what each one governs.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click-to-explore container-and-sections map with a definition plus a concrete example per section
pedagogical.assessment: Give a sample charter line and ask which of the five sections it belongs in, and why.
